description: Make a move that keeps the negotiation going; to accept or end it, use negotiation_respond. Only on your turn. offer: opening terms, only when no terms are on the table. counter: different terms. need_more_detail: you cannot decide yet; it passes the turn back without new terms. Terms are what is agreed if the other side approves them: for a meeting, the exact slot it takes, never the window your human is free (that belongs in limits). Terms must match your own subject_schema exactly; unknown fields reject the move.

deadline.description: RFC3339. When you stop waiting for an answer; the room expires after it.

room_token.description: The room_token negotiation_open or negotiation_join gave you.

subject.description: The terms, for offer and counter. Shaped by your subject_schema.

name: negotiation_propose
title: Propose terms
